title: bench_multi matches a research key's term in a fact's text, but dedup keys now hold term ids with a hash
goal: bench_multi.duplicate_research and worked_key match a research key's term against a fact's text in the form a fact holds it, so a dedup key made from a free-text lack term (batch-size-d2bd91) still counts as worked

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
import bench_multi as B,coord
tid=coord.term_id('batch size',60);key='research:public/x/y:'+tid
fact=lambda n:{'path':'public/x/y.md','text':'Set the export batch size to 512 records (agent %d).'%n,'at':100.0}
B.origin_path=lambda root:'bare';B.agent_email=lambda n:'a%d@example.com'%n
B.added_facts=lambda bare,base,email:[fact(1 if email.startswith('a1') else 2)]
B.claim_windows=lambda store:[(key,'multi-agent1',90.0,200.0)]
B.bench_repro.match_facts=lambda a,b:[(0,0)]
w=B.worked_key('root',{'base':'b'},key,1,'agent-1',{})
d=B.duplicate_research('root',{'base':'b','agents':[{'coord_store':'s'}]},[{'n':1,'agent':'agent-1'},{'n':2,'agent':'agent-2'}])
print('key',key,'worked',w,'duplicates',d);sys.exit(0 if w and d else 1)
